prose: In a Show HN post, a developer shares a custom CHIP-8 assembler written in C++, which has just gained support for the DB/.byte directive so sprites can be embedded directly in the ROM. The author says it should support all original CHIP-8 instructions, with rough edges still being ironed out, and notes it is a first-ever C++ project, written without AI assistance and much of it on livestream.
highlights: Custom CHIP-8 assembler in C++, now with DB/.byte sprite support.
Should cover all original CHIP-8 instructions; rough edges remain.
Author's first C++ project, written by hand without AI.
